title: Parallax Bloom
message:
Parallax Bloom: an original demo-part loop in the manner of Jester's Elysium (Sanity).
B minor, speed 6, intro / A / B / A'. Drums interleaved with a mallet figure, its echo a
row behind, hats on the lead channel, volume slides. Sound library presets only.
Source: songs/amiga_parallax_bloom.gen.js. Rendered and measured, not listened to.
